about: Every frame of the sun-time board as its own PNG at native size (1280 x 720): the game's own pixels, one run of the real game per sun (the Strike, seed 20261009, water on, fog off, the camera on the same patch). board.png is the sheet: 1:1 crops of these frames and nearest-neighbour enlargements of the plane and the tank.
